task.objective: Preserve the original Parquet and valid event rows when resuming an interrupted Collector episode recovery.
open: Recover valid rows after a multibyte UTF-8 tail is torn.
Retain the first pre-recovery Parquet bytes across a serial retry and preserve the source journal and mother recording.
Reproduce both baseline failures and run affected Collector Windows regressions.
